{{Quote|Who's on Quarantine duty?''"<br />"''Perry and Quinze.|Dillian Pressor and Trilli|<ref name="SQ" />}}
'''Quinze''' was serving a term as one of the [[Peacekeeper (Outbound Flight Colony)|Peacekeepers]]<ref name="SQ" /> in [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].<ref name="Date ref">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'' to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]].</ref> As such, Quinze enforced the laws of the [[Outbound Flight Colony]], the government established by those who survived the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] survey [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Outbound Flight Project|''Outbound Flight'']] after it crashed in a [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]] called [[The Redoubt/Legends|the Redoubt]]. In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the [[Human]] [[Trilli]] mentioned to fellow crewman [[Dillian Pressor]] that Quinze was assigned to guard the [[Quarantine section]], where the colony kept [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children under surveillance, alongside [[Perry]].<ref name="SQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quinze was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Survivor's Quest]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="SQ" />
